title: Demo: Coding, Masking, Sponge & SLH-DSA Concrete Bounds (Hill-Climb)
description: Tighten four Lean 4 kernel-verified concrete security bounds (scaled by 100): Reed-Solomon list-decoding proximity gaps, ISW probing-masking leakage, cryptographic sponge indifferentiability, and SLH-DSA Merkle tree soundness. Smaller verified constants hold the record crown. DEMO TRACK: the loss functions in Spec.lean are illustrative polynomials named after real protocols; they are not derived from published security reductions, and scores here are not real security bounds.

tasks.title: Minimize C in 100*rsListLoss(n,k) <= C*(n+k)^2
tasks.description: Tighten claimedRsListFactor (baseline 1400) for Reed-Solomon list-decoding proximity-gap soundness with 0 sorry and 0 custom axioms.

tasks.title: Minimize C in 100*maskingLeakage(s,g) <= C*(s+g)^2
tasks.description: Tighten claimedMaskingFactor (baseline 1500; asymptotic extremum!) for ISW t-probing masking leakage with 0 sorry and 0 custom axioms.
